subtitle: Lesson 13 · The Toolbox Before the Tools

eyebrow: Where logic sits in the save
code:
1. System validations (required, type, length)
2. YOUR validation rules  <- save stops if TRUE
3. Before-save Apex
4. Record saved
5. Approval entry criteria + after-save Apex
6. Flow automation (can loop back to step 2)
caption: A validation rule can never see a value Flow hasn't set yet.
